items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: And it’s out on a label called LaBrava, which is run by the brother of my fiance.

ctx.x: And you do some arrangements too.
Yep. And it’s out on a label called LaBrava, which is run by the brother of my fiance. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -14-
You get distribution across Australia — I mean is that the goal? It’s kind of hard sometimes promoting your own records.
